items.title: Enersense to modernise Sloka substation in Jūrmala, Latvia
items.summary: Enersense to modernise Sloka substation in Jūrmala, Latvia 2026-10-29 15:00:00 Enersense International Plc | Press Release | October 29, 2026 at 16:00:00 EET Energy and infrastructure solutions company Enersense will carry out a modernisation project at the Sloka substation in Jūrmala for the Latvian electricity distribution system operator AS Sadales tīkls. The project includes the construction of a new switchgear building, installation of modern electrical equipment and reconstruction of the existing power network. items.title: Enersense continues substation maintenance across Finland – option-year agreement worth approximately EUR 4 million
items.summary: Enersense continues substation maintenance across Finland – option-year agreement worth approximately EUR 4 million 2026-10-28 08:00:00 Enersense International Oyj | Lehdistötiedote | 28.10.2026 klo 09:00:00 EET Enersense will continue to provide substation maintenance services for transmission system operator Fingrid under an option year included in the agreement. The total value of the agreement is approximately EUR 4 million, and it will remain in force until the end of 2027.
